Originally posted on Legion Pro 5i Gen 10 Intel (16") with RTX 5060
A Powerhouse Laptop That Exceeds Expectations

I’ve been using the Legion Pro 5i Gen 10 (16") with the RTX 5070, and it has surpassed every expectation I had. The build quality feels premium and solid, with a clean, understated design that still gives off that Legion performance vibe. Performance is where this machine truly shines. The combination of Intel’s latest processor and the RTX 5070 delivers exceptional speed whether I’m gaming, editing, or multitasking with heavy workloads. Games run smoothly at high settings, thermals stay controlled, and the fans never get distractingly loud. The 16" display is crisp, bright, and color-accurate, making everything from gaming to productivity feel immersive. The keyboard is comfortable, responsive, and perfect for long sessions. Battery life is better than expected for a performance laptop, and Lenovo’s software makes tuning the system incredibly easy. Overall, this laptop is a fantastic blend of power, build quality, and thoughtful design. I’m genuinely impressed and extremely satisfied with this purchase.

Legion Pro 5i has amazing resolution and speed!

After owning a Lenovo Yoga 14 for over a decade, I upgraded to the Lenovo Pro 5i so that I could process photos and videos more quickly while also upgrading the PCs ability to process music creation with Ableton Live. Incredible screen resolution and ultrafast loading/processing of video and audio software/edits. VERY happy with the purchase and transferring files was a breeze from my old to new Lenovo laptop thanks to their included Update Tool! Highly recommend!
